title: Feedback
description: Tell us what's broken, what's missing or what you'd change. The Shortn team reads every message.
messageHint: {count} / {max} characters. Include the steps, page or link that helps us see what you see.

placeholders.question: What would you like to know?

sent: Thanks — your feedback reached the team.
